method: Read-only interval analysis of saved 0ce4185 startup reports; no browser rerun
conclusion: The covered native calls do not account for the long pause. About 97 percent is inside render with no internal instrumented event. Data cannot distinguish JS/GC from uncovered native calls such as writeBuffer, resource creation and binding updates; it does not establish shader compilation as the cause.
precision: about 0.1 ms; a measured zero does not imply zero true cost
